summary: Rebuild any video file as an editable HyperFrames project - motion graphics, talking heads, live action or AI-generated footage. Measure and watch it, rebuild every layer, then check the render against the original frame by frame.
verification: While building, check a few moments without rendering: npx hyperframes diff <video> . --at t,t,….
Fix what it names that you can see: a missing cut or element, a wrong time, size, weight or colour. Render and diff once more, then stop.
